newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse picks up after decline.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse picks up after decline.

text.p: The Casablanca bourse closed its two-hour session on Thursday 0.26 percent higher as blue chip stocks picked up after having steadily declined in the past few weeks, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 432.61 points from 431.50 points on Wednesday.
"The index has picked after a slump mainly because of the rise in value of ONA group and SNI," a market analyst at Casablanca Finance Group said.
SNI, which has diversified stakes in more than 40 companies, gained five dirhams to 540 dirhams.
SNI is Morocco's second largest private conglomerate with a market capitalisation of more than 5.5 billion dirhams.
ONA Group, the country's largest private group, jumped 10 dirhams to 480 dirhams, a broker said.
Steel giant SONASID was up one dirhams to 325 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 12.2 million dirhams from 14.5 million dirhams on Wednesday.
